labelling_source: Harvested config-integrity corpus: positives are the real intact operational vector (scripts/harvest_sigma_baseline.py) plus intact variations holding the 24 critical ethical anchors at-or-above threshold; negatives are real tamper mutations (anchor collapse, gross-outlier leak, band corruption). The exact baseline is a training positive, so the network passes the real production configuration by construction (DoS guard enforced in main()).
